/etc/rsyslog.d/45-managed-vendor-files.c:
# Mirror package-owned file-only diagnostics without changing daemon paths,
# AppArmor policy, native rotation or auditd ownership. imfile is loaded once in
# 15-audit.conf. No input here is a managed destination (no feedback loops).
# Missing optional package logs are normal. Exact paths, no home-directory globs.
# Isolated ruleset prevents a daemon's quoted text being treated as kernel audit.
ruleset(name="managed_vendor_security") {
  action(type="omfile" file="/var/log/managed/security/vendor.log"
         template="ManagedRuntimeJSON" fileOwner="root" fileGroup="adm"
         fileCreateMode="0640" createDirs="off"
         action.resumeRetryCount="-1" action.resumeInterval="10"
         queue.type="LinkedList" queue.filename="managed-vendor"
         queue.size="500" queue.highWatermark="400" queue.lowWatermark="100"
         queue.maxDiskSpace="16m" queue.maxFileSize="4m" queue.saveOnShutdown="on")
  stop
}
input(type="imfile" File="/var/log/clamav/clamav.log" Tag="clamav-file"
      Facility="local5" Severity="info" Ruleset="managed_vendor_security"
      PersistStateInterval="100" addMetadata="on" reopenOnTruncate="on"
      deleteStateOnFileDelete="on" deleteStateOnFileMove="on")
